1935, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 29 Cont.
Aug. 19 Mrs. Lud. Spranger - - 77 - two weeks in agony with gall stones. Drs. fear if operated ... She is praying to die. Enrolled To-day (50c)
20 Mrs. Julia Murphy (see March 25) here Today quite well though except whole left side quite numb. Daughter looking for position -stenogra- pher.
Nancy & Edwin Jankowski - whooping cough - grandma not well ... Edw'd Collins - 12 last Dec. - died 16th last Friday. Drs. gave him 3 - 4 mo. to live away back 7 years ago ....
Mable Armstrong - 50 - convert - losing sight. One eye removed - still in Hospital. Fears total Bl .. . Page 30 Aug. 21 Tho's Molloy - 75 - of Port Huron - married out of church and dropped its practice.
22 Lawrence A. Cook of T. - 24 - had stroke 8 yrsago. Is quite invalid. Was extremely bright - knew Greek & Latin at 9 yrs. of age. Here To- day 2nd time - finishing $5. Enrollment - wanted to be missioner, now tired of world wants to go to Heaven.
Yvonne Stokes - 39 (Today) threatened with cancer operation on both breasts - has five small children - is partly blind. Wants to live for her family till they grow up a little more.
Herbert Anderson - Episcopelian - 24 - laments he loves his friend so little if at all - peculiarly frank in admitting this want of feeling for neighbor. Gave $2.00 for good cause.
Page 31 25 Edw'd Shaffo - 17 - heart trouble serious - enrolled To-day .....
-
Aug. 24 James Thomas - 7 - Inf. Paral's since a yr. old (Syrian) Parents seldom to communion. Father not since in America - Promise to go frequently.
Mabel E. Armstrong - Convert - 50 - one eye lost in operation to save her from total blindness. Now threatened with loss of 2nd Eye ... Ten operations.
